author: Enginehead
text_post: I have 2 suggestions:  Complete block list where both parties can't see each other: The foe list works ok for hiding posts and messages from people whom you don't like but whom does not repeatedly try to annoy you. If the user A is repeatedly targeting a specific user (user B) and B foe-lists A, the problem is that while user B is not seeing user A's posts, user A is still able to see user B's posts, and hence, is able to continue bothering the other user. A block list (similar to Facebook's where both parties cannot see each other once blocked) would be more helpful in such a case as neither parties are able to see each other. I don't know if foe-listing is going to extend to private messages (have never received messages from someone in my foe list so I don't know for sure) so I'd say that block lists could extend to private messages too. For the sake of continuity in threads, you'll be able to see what the blocked user say when quoted by other posters and see their threads if they are the original poster (all first posts are exempted from being blocked, because some may be important announcements that should not be ignored) as well as able to quote the other person and reply, but the reply will still not be visible to the blocked user. This nips a lot of ongoing quarrels at the bud (which is happening so frequently that it hijacks and derails almost every thread) that goes on for quite a while (ie. Not a one-off matter). It should be reversible but put a reasonable time limit to it (eg. A week of cooling-off period before you can remove someone from your block list, but you can add them back to the block list at any time). Both parties are more likely to stop being upset after a while. Though the downside is that the blocked user may use this opportunity to doxx people who have blocked them and they may not be aware of it if no one else informs them.  Partial block list: I'd say that we keep the foe list for hiding posts you don't want to see, and the block list to prevent someone else from seeing your posts. Tl;dr Function of complete block list: Both parties are not able to see each other at all except for original posts and indirect quotes. Function of partial block list: Blocks a user from seeing your posts (except original posts and indirect quotes from someone else). However, you have to foe list them if you do not want to see them either.

author: ieatboogers
text_post: Personal messages from foes are still allowed; you can see this by going to User control panel, Manage friends and foes, Manage foes, and read up at the top. You can delete messages without reading them, if you wish. You can also turn off private messages from anyone except mods and admins in your Global settings (also under User control panel)
